In this video, I travel to IRAN during a time of war and uncertainty. From b-damaged buildings to lively markets and the streets of Tehran, I witness two completely different sides of the country.
With the threat of renewed b and possible internet shutdowns, I explore what life is really like inside Iran and meet a country beyond the headlines. 🏻
Is Iran as dangerous as the world believes? Join me on this journey to discover the reality of Iran.
